note: P83E T1: written before any shop code. `dev` tunes routing and reading; `sealed` is opened once by the T5 gate and nothing is tuned on it; `mustNot` must never route to shop (coin collecting, timed sorting, stealing, shop management stay in their own game types).
design: Shop = N things from the sentence on a shelf, one drop place (counter with a till, a scale, a pot or cauldron) and a running total.
Every thing carries a number tag from the seed: a price in steps of 0.50 (shown as $), a weight 1-9 (kg) or a plain value 1-9 (points, pages, magic).
The quantity and its unit come from the sentence: 'total price' -> $, 'weight' / 'kilos' -> kg, anything else -> the sentence's word ('score', 'calories').
The player taps a thing; the hero walks to it, picks it up (the carried thing is state), walks to the drop place and puts it down.
The total is recomputed and shown after every placed thing: the number flies from the tag into the total in the HUD.
Goal 'place N': the sentence's count ('three items' -> 3) or a default; the shelf holds exactly N things and all of them go on the counter before the clock runs out.
Goal 'hit the total': the sentence names a target ('exactly 12 dollars', 'until it shows 30 kilos'); the shelf holds more things than needed and only the right ones reach it.
In 'hit the total' a thing that would go over the target is refused and costs one of 3 lives; the generator builds the target from a real subset of the shelf, so a solution always exists.
Doing nothing loses on the clock; the robot ('Show me how') plays a winning order.
The win shows a receipt: every placed thing with its tag and the total line.
